scope: Proposition B.6 (Backward coefficient step) of the manuscript “Memory and precision in noiseless Gaussian regression” (preprints/Memory-and-precision-in-noiseless-Gaussian-regression-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a46ccc95821da009), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume (67). Let H > 0 and let N ≥ 1 be an integer. Let h1, . . . , hN : Sd−1 → [0, 1] be Borel functions satisfying Z B(x,r) hw dσ ≤ Hrβ (x ∈ Rd , r > 0, 1 ≤ w ≤ N). Let gw(A, y) ≥ 0 be Borel functions with P w gw ≤ 1, and define h(s) = EA N X w=1 gw(A, As)hw(s). There is an absolute Cstep ≥ 1 such that Z B(z,R) h dσ ≤ Cd stepN1/p HRβ (z ∈ Rd , R > 0). (83)
